scenarios.prompt: Assess case CG-8101. A grants administration body released supplier payments and the assurance evidence is missing.
scenarios.pattern: A national grants administration body released four supplier payments before any supplier assurance evidence existed

evidence.summary: Four supplier payments above GBP 120,000 left the release queue with an empty assurance evidence field.
The assurance register held no certificate for any of the four suppliers on the release date.
One bulk update set the release check to 'not required' for all four payments on the same morning.

scenarios.prompt: Assess case CG-8202. Check whether another public body has already recorded a related control failure.
scenarios.pattern: A regional housing delivery body repeated the same missing supplier assurance failure on its payment release gate

evidence.summary: Three contractor payments cleared the release gate while the assurance evidence field stayed empty.
One bulk update disabled the same release check for eleven framework supplier records.
Two of the three payments used a framework supplier whose certificate had already expired.

scenarios.prompt: Assess case CG-8303. Check whether a related control failure elsewhere explains the current evidence.
scenarios.pattern: A regional transport authority looks similar, but its payments never reached the release control that failed elsewhere

evidence.summary: All nine payments in the window settled through a standing charge route that bypasses the release gate.
The release check has never been enabled for the standing charge route since the route opened.
Every settled charge carries a current assurance certificate from the named framework supplier.

scenarios.prompt: Assess case CG-8404. A public audit body reports an overdue records retention schedule.
scenarios.pattern: A public audit body has left its records retention schedule fourteen months past its own review date

evidence.summary: The published schedule states a twelve-month review cycle and was last reviewed twenty-six months ago.
Six record classes passed their disposal date with no recorded disposal or hold decision.

scenarios.prompt: Assess case CG-8505 and report the unverifiable control claim.
scenarios.pattern: An unverifiable control claim with no supporting record
